publication.verdict_basis: Microsoft's [workload identity page for AKS](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/aks/workload-identity-overview) states that "workload identity uses the Microsoft Entra v2 token endpoint rather than the IMDS `resource` flow used by managed identity" (read 2026-11-01). In this run, librdkafka's built-in `azure_imds` option, which calls IMDS, never obtained the workload identity: with the workload client ID IMDS answered `Identity not found`, and with no client ID the broker saw only a non-workload principal.

run.failure_cause: nativejwt Job exit 1 at the client-error capture limit
